title: Guns, Buns, & Abs - 30 days
desc:
This program is designed to help with building muscle and burn fat.

The programs works great for weight-loss especially if it’s followed while on a low carb, protein rich diet.

The workouts also require no equipment as well, but feel free to include any weights to challenge yourself further.

ex.note:
Walk a minimum of 10,000 steps per day.

Can be broken up throughout the day.
Should take under 80 mins if walking at a brisk pace.

It’s ok if it takes more time to complete all 10,000 steps.
